paragraphs: At Graphcore you will build the software that validates Graphcore’s machine learning stack, from frameworks to AI accelerator hardware. You will design production-quality test infrastructure that engineers can extend, maintain and rely on as Graphcore’s ML software grows. You will architect scalable test frameworks and build CI/CD pipelines that run across simulators, emulators and physical hardware. This role gives you scope to shape software architecture and developer experience, not just add tests to existing systems.

I have a strong focus on testing, having applied systematic evaluation to verify complex pipelines and ensure correctness. In another project I combined omics and graph techniques to analyse large‑scale biological datasets, processing 1,399 cell lines across 16,385 genes and achieving a clear separation between training and test performance. These experiences demonstrate my ability to construct reliable, reproducible test suites that surface issues early and provide clear evidence of numerical accuracy, directly aligning with Graphcore’s need for rigorous ML stack validation. My work has been carried out in Python within Linux environments, reinforcing testability and maintainability. I designed evaluation frameworks that capture performance metrics across different hardware simulators, enabling developers to compare results consistently. Through iterative refinement I introduced automated regression checks that reduced manual review time and increased confidence in numerical results. These practices align with Graphcore’s emphasis on clear evidence of numerical accuracy and performance across the stack and scalability in production.

I bring proven production expertise, having built end‑to‑end fintech APIs that operate reliably under heavy load and integrate smoothly with existing services. I also containerised critical workloads using Docker, deployed them on AWS Lambda and managed access through IAM policies, ensuring secure and scalable execution. My experience delivering production‑grade software includes designing CI/CD pipelines that automate testing and deployment in Linux environments, reinforcing reliability across simulators and physical hardware. By applying these methods I have consistently reduced deployment friction and improved observability, supporting rapid iteration on complex systems. This background equips me to deliver the production‑ready software Graphcore requires for its ML QA pipelines, enabling integration and automated testing across diverse hardware targets. I used Python scripts to orchestrate test runs and capture performance data, aligning with Graphcore’s focus on scalable testing frameworks. Additionally I have contributed to tooling that streamlines CI/CD workflows, demonstrating my commitment to extensible solutions.
